title: SkyFi MCP Server – Tool Input Schemas
description: JSON Schema definitions for every tool input accepted by the SkyFi MCP server.

SensorType.description: Sensor modality used to capture the imagery.

OrderStatus.description: Current lifecycle status of an order.

POICategory.description: Point-of-interest category used for spatial search.

coordinates.description: Coordinate array whose structure depends on the geometry type.

LocationInput.description: A location expressed as either a GeoJSON geometry or a human-readable address string.

oneOf.description: Free-text address or place name that will be geocoded server-side.

DeliveryOptions.description: Options controlling how imagery is delivered.

search_archive.description: Search the SkyFi archive catalogue for imagery matching spatial, temporal, and sensor criteria.

location.description: Area of interest as GeoJSON geometry or address string.

date_range.description: Temporal window to constrain capture dates.

resolution_min.description: Minimum spatial resolution in metres per pixel.

sensor_type.description: Filter results to a specific sensor modality.

open_data.description: When true, restrict results to openly licensed data.

page_token.description: Opaque cursor returned by a previous search for pagination.

get_archive_details.description: Retrieve full metadata for a single archive image.

archive_id.description: Unique identifier of the archive image.

explore_providers.description: List satellite imagery providers, optionally filtered by location or sensor type.

location.description: Optional location to filter providers with coverage in that area.

estimate_archive_price.description: Get a price estimate for purchasing an archive image.

archive_id.description: Unique identifier of the archive image to price.

get_tasking_quote.description: Request a quote for a new satellite tasking (future capture) over a given area.

location.description: Area of interest for the tasking request.

resolution.description: Desired spatial resolution in metres per pixel.

analyze_feasibility.description: Analyze the feasibility of capturing imagery at a given location within a time window.

resolution.description: Target spatial resolution in metres per pixel.

compare_pricing.description: Compare imagery pricing across providers and resolution tiers for a given location.

resolution_options.description: List of resolution values (metres per pixel) to compare.

place_archive_order.description: Place (or preview) an order for an archive image. Set confirmed=true to execute the purchase.

archive_id.description: Unique identifier of the archive image to order.

confirmed.description: Must be true to execute the order. When false (default) returns a preview only.

place_tasking_order.description: Place (or preview) a tasking order from a previously obtained quote.

quote_id.description: Identifier of the tasking quote to convert into an order.

confirmed.description: Must be true to execute the order. When false (default) returns a preview only.

get_order_status.description: Retrieve the current status and metadata of an order.

list_orders.description: List orders, optionally filtered by status and/or date range.

get_order_images.description: Retrieve download URLs for imagery delivered as part of an order.

setup_aoi_monitoring.description: Create a persistent monitor that watches for new imagery over an area of interest.

resolution_min.description: Minimum acceptable resolution in metres per pixel.

notification_url.description: Webhook URL to receive notifications when new imagery is available.

monitor_id.description: Unique identifier of the monitor to delete.

get_webhook_status.description: Check the delivery status and health of a webhook subscription.

subscription_id.description: Unique identifier of the webhook subscription.

check_notifications.description: Retrieve pending/unread notifications for the authenticated user.

geocode.description: Convert a free-text address or place name into geographic coordinates.

query.description: Address, place name, or landmark to geocode.

reverse_geocode.description: Convert geographic coordinates into a human-readable address.

search_pois.description: Search for points of interest near a location.

location.description: Centre point or area for the POI search.

category.description: Filter results to a specific POI category.

get_area_boundary.description: Retrieve the administrative boundary polygon for a named area.

name.description: Name of the administrative area (city, county, state, country, etc.).

admin_level.description: OSM admin_level to disambiguate results (1 = supranational, 11 = neighbourhood).
